gates.requirement: Canonical coordinates and units are explicit, versioned, precision-bounded, and independent of render/reference coordinates.
Narrative gravity is independent from raw distance and has explicit inputs.
Visual regression and frame-budget evidence are generated from repeatable traversal traces.
Independent replay verifies identity, coordinates, world state, and causal obligations after load.
Historical reconstruction is independently reproducible.
The integrated system has bounded CPU/GPU/memory/I/O/storage budgets and fail-safe degradation.
End-to-end save/replay, crash recovery, deterministic replay, failure injection, and independent qualification are complete.
Budget governor decisions are observable, replayable, and attributed to CPU/GPU/memory/I/O pressure.
Spatial folding cannot collapse independent habitats into one ecological interaction domain.
Overlapping wells use deterministic conflict arbitration independent of thread timing.
A compatibility matrix distinguishes reference-model, hosted operational, native VM, production-scale, and independently qualified profiles.
Vertical reference semantics, gravity direction, and large-world elevation precision are explicit and tested independently of horizontal folding.
8S/Penteract mappings are versioned independently from runtime schemas so mathematical experimentation cannot silently alter canonical save semantics.
Operator performance is bounded with declared per-frame/per-tick cost independent from world canonical population size except through active representation sets.
Remote simulation wells may persist without any camera/renderer consumer when canonical events require continued fidelity.
Qualification includes multi-day/world-age history, compaction, migration, index rebuild, partial corruption, and independent replay.
The release includes a headless deterministic verifier capable of loading a world package/save, replaying Golden World traces, and emitting canonical checkpoint digests without full rendering.
Fold geometry can be evaluated in parallel over independent representation sets while using one versioned fold-policy authority.
LOD qualification compares single-worker and multi-worker canonical checkpoint digests for semantic equivalence.
Hot-reloaded presentation assets are versioned separately from canonical semantic state and can roll back independently.
Materialization qualification includes concurrent dense-region hydration across multiple workers/storage tiers with deterministic interaction readiness.
Transition format versions are independently migratable and replay-compatible according to the compatibility matrix.
Authority-well arbitration is a first-class runtime service with deterministic global ordering and partition-independent canonical ownership.
World-state ledger archives include partition/worker provenance for diagnostics while canonical event meaning remains execution-layout independent.
The final release includes automated conformance suites that compare canonical outcomes across multiple worker counts/layouts and verify equivalent save/replay results.
Qualification includes multi-era query equivalence before/after compaction, archive migration, world expansion, and independent reconstruction.
